entities.name: Sachir
entities.description: Innkeeper of the Akoum Expeditionary House in Akka Town, supposedly a great explorer of Akoum.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who followed the Dragon Scroll toward the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Akoum Expeditionary House
entities.description: Inn run by Sachir in Akka Town.

entities.name: Gurgel Brothers
entities.description: Goblin guides; the last brought Chandra across the Teeth of Akoum before being eaten by a wurm.

entities.name: League of Anowon
entities.description: Group Chandra reached across the Teeth of Akoum.

events.summary: Sachir sells Chandra a series of guides through the mountain passes toward the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: Sachir accepted coins from Chandra and gave her guides

events.summary: The last Gurgel brother brings Chandra across the Teeth of Akoum to the League of Anowon before being eaten by a giant wurm.
events.quote: before he was eaten by a giant wurm

relations.quote: Sachir is the innkeeper and the proprietor of the Akoum Expeditionary House
